editorial:
If you have ever wondered what goes on behind the scenes of a big musical movie, this DVD extra is a real treat. You get to watch six extended pods that cover every part of making Hairspray, from dance and vocal rehearsals to recording sessions, shooting days, and final mixing. You see the cast and crew working hard, laughing, and putting together the songs and dance numbers you love. It feels like being invited backstage, and you get a close look at how much effort goes into every scene.

The best parts are the rehearsal footage and the recording sessions, where you can see the actors learning their moves and singing their hearts out. It is fun and full of energy, though it is clearly made for fans who already love the movie, so casual viewers might find it a bit long. If you are a Hairspray fan, this is a must-watch. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: The final pod wraps up with the completed musical numbers and the finished film coming together. You see the last touches of mixing and editing, and the cast celebrates the end of production. It closes on a happy, upbeat note that leaves you feeling good and ready to watch the movie again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Hairspray or behind-the-scenes filmmaking.
